question: Which one of the following is the correct chronological sequence of the major rock systems of India from oldest to youngest?
questionHindi: भारत की प्रमुख शैल प्रणालियों का प्राचीनतम से नवीनतम की ओर सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम कौन सा है?
hints: Hint 1: Archaean rocks represent the basement complex formed during the cooling of Earth's crust.
Hint 2: Dharwar is the oldest sedimentary rock system formed from erosion of Archaean rocks.
Hint 3: Gondwana was formed much later in the Carboniferous-Permian era.
trapAlert: Do not confuse Cuddapah and Vindhyan sequence; Cuddapah preceded Vindhyan.
explanation: The geological chronological sequence is: Archaean (oldest) -> Dharwar -> Cuddapah -> Vindhyan -> Gondwana -> Deccan Trap -> Tertiary -> Quaternary (youngest).
explanationHindi: सही कालानुक्रम है: आर्कियन (सबसे प्राचीन) -> धारवाड़ -> कुडप्पा -> विंध्यन -> गोंडवाना -> दक्कन ट्रैप -> टर्शियरी -> क्वाटरनरी।

question: In the Northern Plains of India, the coarse gravel and pebble belt lying parallel to the Shiwalik foothills where streams disappear underground is known as:
questionHindi: भारत के उत्तरी मैदानों में शिवालिक की तलहटी के समानांतर स्थित कंकड़-पत्थरों की वह पट्टी जहां नदियां भूमिगत हो जाती हैं, कहलाती है:
hints: Hint 1: This belt is 8 to 16 km wide along the Shiwalik piedmont.
Hint 2: Porosity is extremely high due to heavy gravel deposition.
Hint 3: The marshy zone directly south of it is called Terai.
trapAlert: Do not confuse Bhabar (where rivers disappear) with Terai (where rivers re-emerge).
explanation: Bhabar is an 8–16 km wide belt of coarse gravel deposited by rivers exiting the Himalayas. Due to high porosity, streams sink underground here and re-emerge in the swampy Terai belt to the south.
explanationHindi: भाबर शिवालिक के समानांतर 8 से 16 किमी चौड़ी कंकड़-पत्थरों की पट्टी है। अत्यधिक सरंध्रता के कारण नदियां इसमें लुप्त हो जाती हैं और दक्षिण में तराई में पुनः प्रकट होती हैं।

question: Which of the following passes connects Srinagar with Leh and Kargil, carrying National Highway 1 across the Great Himalayas?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा श्रीनगर को लेह और कारगिल से जोड़ता है और महान हिमालय में NH-1 इसी से होकर गुजरता है?
hints: Hint 1: It is situated at an elevation of ~3,528 m in Ladakh/J&K.
Hint 2: A 14.15 km all-weather bi-directional tunnel is currently under construction here.
Hint 3: Banihal connects Jammu to Srinagar, while this pass connects Srinagar to Leh.
trapAlert: Banihal connects Jammu with Srinagar; Zoji La connects Srinagar with Ladakh.
explanation: Zoji La sits at ~3,528 m on the Great Himalayas, connecting Srinagar Valley with Dras, Kargil, and Leh on NH-1.
explanationHindi: ज़ोजी ला (~3,528 मीटर) श्रीनगर को द्रास, कारगिल और लेह से जोड़ता है।

question: Anamudi, the highest peak in Peninsular India and the Western Ghats (2,695 m), is located in which hill range?
questionHindi: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत और पश्चिमी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी अनामुडी (2,695 मीटर) किस पहाड़ी श्रृंखला में स्थित है?
hints: Hint 1: It is located in the Idukki district of Kerala.
Hint 2: Doddabetta is the highest peak in the Nilgiris (2,637 m), not Anamudi.
Hint 3: The name literally translates to 'Elephant Head' in Malayalam/Tamil.
trapAlert: Doddabetta is in Nilgiris; Anamudi is in Anamalai Hills.
explanation: Anamudi (2,695 m) is in the Anamalai Hills of Kerala inside Eravikulam National Park. It is the highest peak in South India.
explanationHindi: अनामुडी (2,695 मीटर) केरल की अनामलाई पहाड़ियों में स्थित दक्षिण भारत की सर्वोच्च चोटी है।

question: Which of the following is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन पूर्वी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी है?
hints: Hint 1: It is located in the Araku Valley of Visakhapatnam district.
Hint 2: Its elevation is 1,690 m, surpassing Mahendragiri (1,501 m).
Hint 3: Older textbooks often cited Mahendragiri, but modern surveys confirm this peak.
trapAlert: Mahendragiri was traditionally cited, but Jindhagada (1,690 m) is the undisputed highest peak.
explanation: Arma Konda / Jindhagada Peak (1,690 m) in Andhra Pradesh is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats, followed by Deomali (1,672 m) and Mahendragiri (1,501 m).
explanationHindi: पूर्वी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी जिंधागड़ा / अरमा कोंडा (1,690 मीटर, आंध्र प्रदेश) है।

question: The Ten Degree Channel (10° Channel) separates which of the following pairs of island territories?
questionHindi: दस डिग्री चैनल (10° Channel) निम्नलिखित में से किस द्वीप समूह युग्म को अलग करता है?
hints: Hint 1: It separates the Andaman archipelago from the Nicobar archipelago.
Hint 2: Duncan Passage separates South Andaman from Little Andaman.
Hint 3: The 10°N latitude passes directly between Little Andaman and Car Nicobar.
trapAlert: Duncan passage is between South & Little Andaman; 10° Channel is between Little Andaman & Car Nicobar.
explanation: The 10° Channel is ~150 km wide along the 10°N parallel, separating Little Andaman (Andaman group) from Car Nicobar (Nicobar group).
explanationHindi: 10 डिग्री चैनल लिटिल अंडमान को कार निकोबार से अलग करता है।

question: The Indian Standard Meridian (82°30'E) does NOT pass through which of the following states?
questionHindi: भारतीय मानक समय रेखा (82°30' पूर्व) निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य से होकर नहीं गुजरती है?
hints: Hint 1: 82°30'E passes through five Indian states from North to South.
Hint 2: It passes near Mirzapur in UP, then MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.
Hint 3: It lies east of Telangana.
trapAlert: Telangana does not touch 82°30'E; it passes through Andhra Pradesh instead.
explanation: The 82°30'E meridian passes through 5 states: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh. It does not pass through Telangana.
explanationHindi: 82°30' पूर्व देशांतर रेखा 5 राज्यों (यूपी, एमपी, छत्तीसगढ़, ओडिशा, आंध्र प्रदेश) से गुजरती है; यह तेलंगाना से नहीं गुजरती।

question: Consider the following Himalayan longitudinal valleys (Duns). Dehradun, Kotli Dun, and Patli Dun are located between which two ranges?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित हिमालयी अनुदैर्ध्य घाटियों (दूं) पर विचार करें। देहरादून, कोटली दून और पाटली दून किन दो पर्वत श्रेणियों के बीच स्थित हैं?
optionsHindi: शिवालिक श्रेणी और भारत-गंगा का मैदान
hints: Hint 1: They are flat-bottomed structural valleys formed during the late stage of folding.
Hint 2: Dehradun is the largest of these valleys (~35 km long).
Hint 3: They sit between Himachal (Lesser Himalaya) and the outermost Shiwaliks.
trapAlert: Do not place Duns between Great and Lesser Himalayas (which host Kashmir Valley).
explanation: Duns are flat-bottomed longitudinal valleys situated between the Lesser Himalayas (Himachal) and the Outer Himalayas (Shiwalik Range).
explanationHindi: दून (जैसे देहरादून) लघु हिमालय और शिवालिक श्रेणी के बीच स्थित अनुदैर्ध्य घाटियाँ हैं।

question: Through which of the following mountain gaps in the Western Ghats does the primary rail and road freight corridor between Mumbai and Pune pass?
questionHindi: पश्चिमी घाट के निम्नलिखित में से किस पर्वतीय दर्रे से होकर मुंबई और पुणे के बीच प्राथमिक रेल और सड़क माल ढुलाई गलियारा गुजरता है?
hints: Hint 1: It is also known as Khandala Ghat.
Hint 2: Thal Ghat connects Mumbai with Nashik/Agra.
Hint 3: Bhor Ghat carries the Mumbai-Pune Expressway (NH-48).
trapAlert: Thal Ghat = Mumbai to Nashik; Bhor Ghat = Mumbai to Pune.
explanation: Bhor Ghat connects the Konkan coast (Mumbai/Navi Mumbai) with Pune on the Deccan Plateau across the Western Ghats escarpment.
explanationHindi: भोर घाट (खंडाला घाट) मुंबई को पुणे और दक्षिणी दक्कन से जोड़ता है।

question: In the Thar Desert, crescent-shaped shifting sand dunes with horns pointing in the direction of the wind are known as:
questionHindi: थार मरुस्थल में हवा की दिशा में नुकीले सिरों वाले अर्धचंद्राकार बालू के टीलों को क्या कहा जाता है?
hints: Hint 1: They are the most characteristic aeolian depositional landform in arid zones.
Hint 2: Seif is a longitudinal dune.
Hint 3: Barchans form transverse to the wind direction with a gentle windward slope.
trapAlert: Seifs are longitudinal; Barchans are crescent-shaped.
explanation: Barchans are crescent-shaped dunes with convex windward slopes and concave slip faces pointing downwind, common in western Rajasthan.
explanationHindi: बरखान हवा की दिशा में मुड़े हुए सींगों वाले अर्धचंद्राकार रेत के टीले होते हैं।

question: Which of the following statements is TRUE regarding the Aravalli Range?

options: Oldest fold mountain system in India; relic residual range; Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) is its highest peak.
It was formed during the Pleistocene era as a volcanic plateau.
It forms the primary boundary between India and Myanmar.
It is entirely composed of Quaternary alluvium.
optionsHindi: Oldest fold mountain system in India; relic residual range; Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) is its highest peak.
इसका निर्माण प्लेइस्टोसिन युग में ज्वालामुखीय पठार के रूप में हुआ था।
यह भारत और म्यांमार के बीच प्राथमिक सीमा बनाता है।
यह पूरी तरह से क्वाटरनरी जलोढ़ से बना है।
hints: Hint 1: Recall the tectonic origin and geographical location of Aravalli Range.
Hint 2: Review whether it is Peninsular, Himalayan, or Insular.
Hint 3: Oldest fold mountain system in India; relic residual range; ...
trapAlert: Be careful not to mix up peninsular relic mountains with young fold mountains.
explanation: Aravalli Range: Oldest fold mountain system in India; relic residual range; Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) is its highest peak.
explanationHindi: अरावली पर्वतमाला: Oldest fold mountain system in India; relic residual range; Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) is its highest peak.

question: Consider statement 26: The Malda Gap (Garo-Rajmahal Gap) separates which two morphological units of India?
questionHindi: मालदा गैप (गारो-राजमहल गैप) भारत की किन दो भू-आकृतिक इकाइयों को अलग करता है?
options: The Peninsular Plateau and the Meghalaya (Shillong) Plateau
The Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats
The Greater Himalayas and the Shiwalik Range
The Northern Plains and the Thar Desert
hints: Hint 1: Ganga and Brahmaputra rivers flow through this down-faulted gap.
Hint 2: Meghalaya plateau is structurally part of the Peninsular craton, not the Himalayas.
Hint 3: The gap lies between Rajmahal Hills in Jharkhand and Garo Hills in Meghalaya.
trapAlert: Do not assume Meghalaya plateau is Himalayan; it is an eastward detached piece of the Peninsular shield.
explanation: The Malda Gap was formed by down-faulting between the Rajmahal hills and Garo hills, later filled with alluvium by Ganga-Brahmaputra.
explanationHindi: मालदा गैप गंगा-ब्रह्मपुत्र द्वारा भरे गए गर्त के रूप में प्रायद्वीपीय पठार को मेघालय पठार से अलग करता है।

The Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats
The Greater Himalayas and the Shiwalik Range
The Northern Plains and the Thar Desert
hints: Hint 1: Ganga and Brahmaputra rivers flow through this down-faulted gap.
Hint 2: Meghalaya plateau is structurally part of the Peninsular craton, not the Himalayas.
Hint 3: The gap lies between Rajmahal Hills in Jharkhand and Garo Hills in Meghalaya.
trapAlert: Do not assume Meghalaya plateau is Himalayan; it is an eastward detached piece of the Peninsular shield.
explanation: The Malda Gap was formed by down-faulting between the Rajmahal hills and Garo hills, later filled with alluvium by Ganga-Brahmaputra.
explanationHindi: मालदा गैप गंगा-ब्रह्मपुत्र द्वारा भरे गए गर्त के रूप में प्रायद्वीपीय पठार को मेघालय पठार से अलग करता है।

question: Consider the following tributaries of the Indus river: 1. Chenab, 2. Jhelum, 3. Ravi, 4. Sutlej. Which one of the following joins directly into the Indus without meeting another intermediate river?
questionHindi: सिंधु नदी की निम्नलिखित सहायक नदियों पर विचार करें: 1. चिनाब, 2. झेलम, 3. रावी, 4. सतलुज। इनमें से कौन सी सीधे सिंधु नदी में मिलती है बिना किसी अन्य मध्यवर्ती नदी में मिले?
hints: Hint 1: Jhelum joins Chenab near Trimmu.
Hint 2: Ravi joins Chenab near Sarai Sidhu.
Hint 3: Sutlej joins Chenab at Uch/Mithankot as the Panjnad, and the combined Panjnad (predominantly Chenab) empties into the Indus.
trapAlert: Chenab gathers the waters of Jhelum, Ravi, and Sutlej before discharging into the Indus.
explanation: Jhelum joins Chenab; Ravi joins Chenab; Sutlej receives Beas and then joins Chenab. The combined five rivers flow as Panjnad (headed by Chenab) directly into the Indus near Mithankot.
explanationHindi: झेलम, रावी और सतलुज सभी अंततः चिनाब में मिलती हैं और पंचनद के रूप में चिनाब सीधे सिंधु नदी में विलीन होती है।

question: At which of the following confluences (Prayags) do the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers meet to form the Ganga?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से किस संगम (प्रयाग) पर अलकनंदा और भागीरथी नदियाँ मिलकर गंगा बनाती हैं?
hints: Hint 1: It is the lowest and most sacred of the Panch Prayags.
Hint 2: Rudraprayag is Alaknanda + Mandakini.
Hint 3: Devprayag is the confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi.
trapAlert: Rudraprayag = Alaknanda + Mandakini; Devprayag = Alaknanda + Bhagirathi.
explanation: Devprayag is the sacred confluence in Garhwal Uttarakhand where Bhagirathi and Alaknanda join, from which point onwards the river is officially called the Ganga.
explanationHindi: देवप्रयाग में भागीरथी और अलकनंदा का संगम होता है, जिसके बाद इसे आधिकारिक तौर पर गंगा कहा जाता है।

question: Which of the following is a LEFT-BANK tributary of the Ganga?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन गंगा की बाईं तट (Left-Bank) की सहायक नदी है?
hints: Hint 1: Look in the direction the river flows (eastward/southeastward).
Hint 2: Rivers entering from the Himalayan north are left-bank tributaries.
Hint 3: Yamuna and Son enter from the southern/right-bank side.
trapAlert: Yamuna, Son, and Punpun are right-bank; Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi are left-bank.
explanation: Gandak originates in the Nepal Himalayas and joins the Ganga on its left bank near Patna (Hajipur).
explanationHindi: गंडक नेपाल हिमालय से निकलकर हाजीपुर (पटना) के पास गंगा के बाएं तट पर मिलती है।

question: Why do the Narmada and Tapi rivers flow westward into the Arabian Sea, unlike most other major Peninsular rivers?
questionHindi: नर्मदा और तापी नदियां अधिकांश अन्य प्रमुख प्रायद्वीपीय नदियों के विपरीत पश्चिम की ओर अरब सागर में क्यों बहती हैं?
options: They flow through structural rift valleys (graben)
They have higher water discharge than eastern rivers
The Himalayas tilt the northern plateau southward
optionsHindi: वे भ्रंश घाटियों (Rift Valleys) से होकर बहती हैं
उनमें पूर्वी नदियों की तुलना में अधिक जल निर्वहन होता है
हिमालय उत्तरी पठार को दक्षिण की ओर झुकाता है
hints: Hint 1: The general slope of the Peninsular plateau is from West to East.
Hint 2: Faulting occurred during the breakup of Gondwana and Himalayan collision.
Hint 3: Narmada flows between the Vindhyas and Satpuras in a tectonic trough.
trapAlert: Rift valleys dictate their course against the regional eastward plateau slope.
explanation: Narmada and Tapi flow through tectonic rift valleys (graben) formed by faulting between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges, sloping westwards into the Gulf of Khambhat.
explanationHindi: नर्मदा और तापी विंध्य और सतपुड़ा के बीच भ्रंश घाटी (Rift Valley) से होकर बहती हैं।

question: Which of the following is the world's largest inhabited freshwater river island, situated on the Brahmaputra River in Assam?
questionHindi: असम में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी पर स्थित विश्व का सबसे बड़ा आबाद मीठे पानी का नदी द्वीप कौन सा है?
hints: Hint 1: It was declared a district of Assam in 2016.
Hint 2: Formed by the bifurcation of Brahmaputra and Kherkutia Xuti joined by Subansiri.
Hint 3: Cultural center of Neo-Vaishnavite Satras established by Srimanta Sankardev.
trapAlert: Umananda is the smallest inhabited river island in the world; Majuli is the largest.
explanation: Majuli Island on the Brahmaputra in Assam is the world's largest freshwater river island, renowned for its Vaishnavite Satras.
explanationHindi: माजुली असम में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी पर स्थित विश्व का सबसे बड़ा आबाद नदी द्वीप है।

question: Regarding the drainage basin of the Godavari, which of the following features is CORRECT?
questionHindi: गोदावरी नदी के अपवाह तंत्र के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विशेषता सही है?
options: Pranhita (combined Wardha, Penganga, Wainganga) is its notable tributary/feature: Largest tributary of Godavari by discharge, entering on the left bank.
It flows north into the Yamuna river directly from the Himalayas.
It forms the largest delta in the Arabian Sea.
It is entirely non-perennial and originates in the Thar Desert.
optionsHindi: Pranhita (combined Wardha, Penganga, Wainganga): Largest tributary of Godavari by discharge, entering on the left bank.
यह सीधे हिमालय से निकलकर उत्तर की ओर यमुना नदी में मिलती है।
यह अरब सागर में सबसे बड़ा डेल्टा बनाती है।
यह पूरी तरह से गैर-बारहमासी है और थार मरुस्थल से निकलती है।
hints: Hint 1: Recall the key tributaries of Godavari.
Hint 2: Review peninsular vs Himalayan drainage networks.
Hint 3: Pranhita (combined Wardha, Penganga, Wainganga)
trapAlert: Identify the authentic basin relationship for Godavari.
explanation: Godavari: Pranhita (combined Wardha, Penganga, Wainganga) — Largest tributary of Godavari by discharge, entering on the left bank.
explanationHindi: गोदावरी: Pranhita (combined Wardha, Penganga, Wainganga) — Largest tributary of Godavari by discharge, entering on the left bank.

question: Regarding the drainage basin of the Krishna, which of the following features is CORRECT?
questionHindi: कृष्णा नदी के अपवाह तंत्र के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विशेषता सही है?
options: Tungabhadra is its notable tributary/feature: Largest tributary of Krishna, formed by the confluence of Tunga and Bhadra at Kudli.
It flows north into the Yamuna river directly from the Himalayas.
It forms the largest delta in the Arabian Sea.
It is entirely non-perennial and originates in the Thar Desert.
optionsHindi: Tungabhadra: Largest tributary of Krishna, formed by the confluence of Tunga and Bhadra at Kudli.
यह सीधे हिमालय से निकलकर उत्तर की ओर यमुना नदी में मिलती है।
यह अरब सागर में सबसे बड़ा डेल्टा बनाती है।
यह पूरी तरह से गैर-बारहमासी है और थार मरुस्थल से निकलती है।
hints: Hint 1: Recall the key tributaries of Krishna.
Hint 2: Review peninsular vs Himalayan drainage networks.
Hint 3: Tungabhadra
trapAlert: Identify the authentic basin relationship for Krishna.
explanation: Krishna: Tungabhadra — Largest tributary of Krishna, formed by the confluence of Tunga and Bhadra at Kudli.
explanationHindi: कृष्णा: Tungabhadra — Largest tributary of Krishna, formed by the confluence of Tunga and Bhadra at Kudli.

question: Regarding the drainage basin of the Kaveri, which of the following features is CORRECT?
questionHindi: कावेरी नदी के अपवाह तंत्र के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विशेषता सही है?
options: Amravati & Bhavani is its notable tributary/feature: Major right-bank tributaries of Kaveri entering in Tamil Nadu.
It flows north into the Yamuna river directly from the Himalayas.
It forms the largest delta in the Arabian Sea.

question: Which of the following atmospheric jet streams is primarily responsible for steering winter temperate cyclones (Western Disturbances) into northwestern India?
questionHindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वायुमंडलीय जेट स्ट्रीम उत्तर-पश्चिमी भारत में शीतकालीन शीतोष्ण चक्रवातों (पश्चिमी विक्षोभ) को लाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से जिम्मेदार है?
hints: Hint 1: It blows from west to east in the upper troposphere (~9–12 km altitude) south of the Himalayas in winter.
Hint 2: It steers depressions originating over the Mediterranean Sea across Iraq, Iran, and Pakistan.
Hint 3: In summer, it withdraws north of the Himalayas, allowing the monsoon to burst.
trapAlert: Tropical Easterly Jet is a summer phenomenon associated with Tibetan heating; Subtropical Westerly Jet brings winter rains.
explanation: The Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream bifurcates around the Tibetan plateau in winter; its southern branch flows along the southern edge of the Himalayas, steering Western Disturbances into northwest India.
explanationHindi: उपोष्णकटिबंधीय पश्चिमी जेट स्ट्रीम (Subtropical Westerly Jet) भूमध्य सागर से आने वाले पश्चिमी विक्षोभों को शीतकाल में उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत में लाती है।

question: In Bengal and Assam, the violent evening thunderstorms accompanied by torrential rains that occur in the pre-monsoon summer season are known as:
questionHindi: बंगाल और असम में पूर्व-मानसून ग्रीष्म ऋतु में मूसलाधार बारिश के साथ आने वाले तीव्र सायंकालीन तूफानों को क्या कहा जाता है?
hints: Hint 1: The name literally means 'Calamity of the month of Baisakh'.
Hint 2: Loo is a hot, dry, dusty wind in the northern plains.
Hint 3: In Assam, these storms are called 'Bardoli Chheerha'.
trapAlert: Loo is hot and dry without rain; Kalbaishakhi brings sudden heavy rain beneficial to tea and jute.
explanation: Kalbaishakhi (Nor'westers) are severe local convective storms in Bengal and Assam during April-May, highly beneficial for tea, jute, and early paddy crops.
explanationHindi: बंगाल और असम में ग्रीष्म ऋतु के इन तीव्र तूफानों को कालवैशाखी (नॉर्वेस्टर) कहा जाता है, जो चाय और जूट के लिए लाभकारी होते हैं।

question: The Coromandel Coast of Tamil Nadu receives the bulk of its annual rainfall during which of the following periods?
questionHindi: तमिलनाडु के कोरोमंडल तट पर वार्षिक वर्षा का अधिकांश भाग निम्नलिखित में से किस अवधि में प्राप्त होता है?
hints: Hint 1: Tamil Nadu lies in the rain-shadow of the Western Ghats during the Southwest Monsoon.
Hint 2: Winds reversing direction blow from northeast to southwest.
Hint 3: As these dry continental winds cross the Bay of Bengal, they pick up moisture and hit the Tamil Nadu coast.
trapAlert: Unlike most of India which gets rain in June-Sept, Tamil Nadu's primary rainy season is Oct-Dec.
explanation: Tamil Nadu remains largely dry in summer due to Western Ghats rain-shadow, but receives 50-60% of its annual rainfall from October to December via the Northeast (Retreating) Monsoon picking moisture over the Bay of Bengal.
explanationHindi: कोरोमंडल तट अक्टूबर से दिसंबर के दौरान उत्तर-पूर्वी (लौटते हुए) मानसून से बंगाल की खाड़ी से नमी ग्रहण करके अपनी अधिकांश वर्षा प्राप्त करता है।

question: With reference to the Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), consider the following statements: 1. A positive IOD is characterized by warmer sea surface temperatures in the western Indian Ocean compared to the eastern Indian Ocean. 2. A positive IOD generally suppresses the Indian Southwest Monsoon. Which statement is correct?
questionHindi: हिंद महासागर द्विध्रुव (IOD) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: 1. सकारात्मक IOD की विशेषता पूर्वी हिंद महासागर की तुलना में पश्चिमी हिंद महासागर में समुद्र की सतह का अधिक गर्म तापमान होना है। 2. एक सकारात्मक IOD आम तौर पर भारतीय दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून को कमजोर करता है। कौन सा कथन सही है?
hints: Hint 1: Statement 1 correctly describes the sea surface temperature gradient.
Hint 2: Warmer western Indian Ocean enhances evaporation and moisture supply to India.
Hint 3: Therefore, a positive IOD enhances the Southwest Monsoon, often neutralizing an El Niño event.
trapAlert: Remember: Positive IOD = Good for Indian Monsoon; El Niño = Bad for Indian Monsoon.
explanation: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because a Positive IOD enhances monsoon rainfall over India by increasing convection over the Arabian Sea and strengthening the monsoon flow.
explanationHindi: कथन 1 सही है। सकारात्मक IOD भारतीय मानसून को मजबूत करता है (कमजोर नहीं), इसलिए कथन 2 गलत है।

explanationHindi: सोमाली जेट: Low-level cross-equatorial atmospheric jet that transports massive moisture from East Africa to the west coast of India.

question: Which of the following best describes the role of Mawsynram Precipitation in Indian climatology?
questionHindi: भारतीय जलवायु विज्ञान में मौसिनराम वर्षा की भूमिका का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा करता है?
options: Funnel-shaped orientation of the Khasi, Garo, and Jaintia hills forces the Bay of Bengal branch into intense orographic uplift.

It prevents cyclonic storms in the Bay of Bengal.

question: Question 145: As one moves from Kolkata to Patna, Prayagraj, and Delhi along the Northern Plains, how does the average monsoon rainfall vary?
questionHindi: प्रश्न 145: उत्तरी मैदानों में कोलकाता से पटना, प्रयागराज और दिल्ली की ओर जाने पर औसत मानसूनी वर्षा किस प्रकार परिवर्तित होती है?
options: It steadily decreases from East to West
It steadily increases from East to West
It peaks at Delhi and is lowest at Kolkata
optionsHindi: यह पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर लगातार घटती है
यह पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर लगातार बढ़ती है
यह पूरे क्षेत्र में पूरी तरह से एक समान रहती है
यह दिल्ली में चरम पर होती है और कोलकाता में सबसे कम होती है
hints: Hint 1: The Bay of Bengal branch enters from the east and moves westward.
Hint 2: Moisture content progressively depletes as the winds travel inland.

trapAlert: Monsoon rainfall in the Indo-Gangetic plain decreases from East to West and South to North.
explanation: Rainfall decreases westward: Kolkata (~150 cm) -> Patna (~100 cm) -> Prayagraj (~90 cm) -> Delhi (~60 cm) as moisture sheds along the track.

explanation: Rainfall decreases westward: Kolkata (~150 cm) -> Patna (~100 cm) -> Prayagraj (~90 cm) -> Delhi (~60 cm) as moisture sheds along the track.

question: Which of the following soil orders/classes covers the largest percentage of India's total geographical area (~40%)?

hints: Hint 1: It is deposited by the major river systems of India.

trapAlert: Alluvial is 40%; Red is 18.5%; Black is 15%; Laterite is 4.3%.
explanation: Alluvial soil covers approximately 40% (1.5 million sq km) of India's total land area, primarily in the Northern Plains and coastal deltas.

question: Black (Regur) soils of the Deccan Trap are known for their unique 'self-ploughing' characteristic primarily because:
questionHindi: दक्कन ट्रैप की काली (रेगुर) मिट्टी अपने अनोखे 'स्व-जुताई' (Self-ploughing) के गुण के लिए जानी जाती है, मुख्य रूप से क्योंकि:
options: They contain high proportions of sand enabling deep drainage
They develop wide, deep cracks upon drying due to high montmorillonite clay content
Earthworms constantly churn the upper soil horizons
They are deposited annually by river floodwaters
optionsHindi: उनमें बालू का उच्च अनुपात होता है जिससे जल निकासी आसान होती है
मोंटमोरिलोनाइट क्ले की उच्च मात्रा के कारण सूखने पर इनमें चौड़ी, गहरी दरारें विकसित हो जाती हैं
केंचुए ऊपरी मृदा परतों को लगातार उलटते रहते हैं
वे नदी की बाढ़ द्वारा प्रतिवर्ष जमा की जाती हैं
hints: Hint 1: Regur soil swells enormously when wet and contracts when dry.
Hint 2: The cracks allow surface soil to fall into deep crevices, facilitating aeration.
Hint 3: It is formed from basaltic lava weathering.
trapAlert: Self-ploughing is a physical shrinkage-swelling process, not biological earthworm action.
explanation: Black soil has high montmorillonite clay content. When dry, it contracts severely, forming deep cracks. Loose topsoil falls into these cracks, naturally turning and aerating the soil ('self-ploughing').
explanationHindi: काली मिट्टी में क्ले की अधिकता के कारण सूखने पर गहरी दरारें पड़ जाती हैं जिससे मृदा का स्वतः वायु-संचार होता है, जिसे 'स्व-जुताई' कहते हैं।

question: Laterite soil, despite being formed in regions of heavy tropical rainfall, is generally infertile for food grain cultivation because:
questionHindi: लैटेराइट मिट्टी भारी उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षा वाले क्षेत्रों में बनने के बावजूद खाद्यान्न की खेती के लिए आम तौर पर अनुपजाऊ होती है, क्योंकि:
options: Intense leaching washes away silica and soluble bases, leaving only insoluble iron and aluminium oxides
It is contaminated with excess volcanic sulfur
It lacks any parent mineral material
It remains perpetually frozen under alpine permafrost
optionsHindi: तीव्र निक्षालन (Leaching) सिलिका और घुलनशील लवणों को बहा ले जाता है, केवल अघुलनशील लौह और एल्युमिनियम ऑक्साइड शेष बचते हैं
यह अत्यधिक ज्वालामुखीय सल्फर से दूषित है
इसमें किसी मूल खनिज पदार्थ का अभाव होता है
यह अल्पाइन पर्माफ्रॉस्ट के तहत हमेशा जमी रहती है
hints: Hint 1: High rainfall and high temperatures cause intense chemical weathering.
Hint 2: The process of desilication removes nutrients like lime, potash, and nitrogen.
Hint 3: It forms a hard brick-like crust (used as building stones) upon drying.
trapAlert: High rainfall causes nutrient leaching (loss), not enrichment.
explanation: Laterite soil forms under heavy seasonal rainfall where intense leaching (desilication) removes soluble silica, nitrogen, potash, and lime, leaving nutrient-poor iron and aluminium sesquioxides.
explanationHindi: अत्यधिक वर्षा के कारण तीव्र निक्षालन (Leaching) से सिलिका और पोषक तत्व बह जाते हैं, जिससे लैटेराइट मिट्टी कृषि के लिए कम उपजाऊ रह जाती है।

question: Which is the most widespread natural forest type in India, covering a broad belt receiving 70–200 cm annual rainfall?
questionHindi: भारत में सबसे व्यापक प्राकृतिक वन प्रकार कौन सा है, जो 70-200 सेमी वार्षिक वर्षा प्राप्त करने वाले एक विस्तृत क्षेत्र को आच्छादित करता है?
hints: Hint 1: These trees shed their leaves for 6 to 8 weeks during the dry spring/summer.
Hint 2: Subdivided into moist deciduous (Sal dominant) and dry deciduous (Teak dominant).
Hint 3: They cover the vast majority of the Peninsular plateau and Himalayan foothills.
trapAlert: Evergreen forests are limited to heavy rainfall pockets (>200 cm); Deciduous forests are the most widespread.
explanation: Tropical Deciduous (Monsoon) forests are the most extensive forest ecosystem in India, covering over 60% of total forest area.
explanationHindi: उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती (मानसूनी) वन भारत में सबसे अधिक क्षेत्रफल पर पाए जाने वाले वन हैं।

question: Mangrove vegetation (tidal forests) exhibits which of the following specialized physiological adaptations to survive in saline, waterlogged coastal mud?
questionHindi: मैंग्रोव वनस्पति (ज्वारीय वन) लवणीय, जलभराव वाले तटीय कीचड़ में जीवित रहने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस विशेष शारीरिक अनुकूलन को प्रदर्शित करती है?
options: Deep taproots to reach groundwater aquifers
Vertical breathing roots (pneumatophores) and viviparous germination
Needle-like waxy leaves to withstand sub-zero frost
optionsHindi: भूजल तक पहुंचने के लिए गहरी मूसला जड़ें
ऊर्ध्वाधर श्वसन जड़ें (न्यूमेटोफोर) और सजीव प्रजकता (विविपेरी)
सर्दियों के महीनों में पत्तियां गिराना
शून्य से नीचे के पाले को सहने के लिए सुई जैसी मोमी पत्तियां
hints: Hint 1: Coastal mud is waterlogged and severely oxygen-deficient (anaerobic).
Hint 2: Stilt roots support the trunk; breathing roots project upwards into the air.
Hint 3: Seeds germinate while still attached to the parent plant (vivipary).
trapAlert: Pneumatophores are aerial roots for respiration; taproots are for desert xerophytes.
explanation: Mangroves have vertical breathing roots (pneumatophores) that project above the tidal water to take in atmospheric oxygen, and exhibit vivipary to establish seedlings in shifting muddy sediment.

question: Question 262: Under the Forest Survey of India (FSI) classification, what canopy density defines 'Very Dense Forest' (VDF)?
questionHindi: प्रश्न 262: भारतीय वन सर्वेक्षण (FSI) के अनुसार, कौन सा वितान घनत्व (Canopy Density) 'अति सघन वन' (VDF) को परिभाषित करता है?
optionsHindi: 70% और उससे अधिक का वितान घनत्व
40% और 70% के बीच का वितान घनत्व
10% और 40% के बीच का वितान घनत्व
hints: Hint 1: VDF is the highest tier of canopy closure.
Hint 2: Moderately Dense Forest (MDF) is 40% to 70%.
Hint 3: Very Dense Forest is >=70%.
trapAlert: VDF >=70%; MDF = 40-70%; Open Forest = 10-40%; Scrub <10%.
explanation: The Forest Survey of India defines Very Dense Forest (VDF) as lands with tree canopy density of 70% and above.
explanationHindi: 70% या उससे अधिक वितान घनत्व वाले वनों को 'अति सघन वन' (VDF) कहा जाता है।

question: In India, approximately 98% of total coal reserves and production belong to which of the following geological formations?
questionHindi: भारत में, कुल कोयला भंडार और उत्पादन का लगभग 98% निम्नलिखित में से किस भूगर्भीय संरचना से संबंधित है?
hints: Hint 1: Formed around 250 million years ago in the Carboniferous-Permian period.
Hint 2: Deposited in down-faulted river troughs like Damodar, Son, Mahanadi, Godavari.
Hint 3: Tertiary coal (Assam, Meghalaya) accounts for only ~2%.
trapAlert: Dharwar rocks hold metallic ores; Gondwana rocks hold 98% of India's coal.
explanation: Gondwana coal formations (~250 Ma) hold 98% of India's coal reserves (bituminous non-coking and coking coal) in the Damodar, Mahanadi, and Godavari valleys.
explanationHindi: भारत का लगभग 98% कोयला भंडार गोंडवाना काल (लगभग 25 करोड़ वर्ष पूर्व) की अवसादी चट्टानों में पाया जाता है।

Hint 2: Oil was first discovered here in the late 19th century.
Hint 3: Often called the 'Birthplace of Indian Oil Industry'.
trapAlert: Digboi is the oldest (1901); Jamnagar is the largest single-site refinery in the world.
explanation: Digboi Refinery in Assam was commissioned on 11 December 1901, making it the oldest continuously operating refinery in Asia.
explanationHindi: असम की डिगबोई रिफाइनरी (1901) भारत और एशिया की सबसे पुरानी तेल रिफाइनरी है।

question: According to the Bureau of Indian Standards (IS 1893:2016), which of the following regions of India falls in the highest seismic risk category: SEISMIC ZONE V?
questionHindi: भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (IS 1893:2016) के अनुसार, भारत का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा क्षेत्र उच्चतम भूकंपीय जोखिम श्रेणी: भूकंपीय क्षेत्र V (Zone V) में आता है?
options: Entire Northeast India, Kutch (Gujarat), and parts of Jammu & Kashmir/Himachal/Uttarakhand
National Capital Region of Delhi and Western Uttar Pradesh
The crystalline Peninsular Shield of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu
optionsHindi: संपूर्ण पूर्वोत्तर भारत, कच्छ (गुजरात), और जम्मू एवं कश्मीर/हिमाचल/उत्तराखंड के भाग
राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र दिल्ली और पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश
कर्नाटक और तमिलनाडु का क्रिस्टलीय प्रायद्वीपीय शील्ड
hints: Hint 1: Zone V has a seismic zone factor of 0.36 (very severe ground shaking).
Hint 2: Delhi-NCR falls in Zone IV (Severe).
Hint 3: Active collision boundary in Himalayas/Northeast and the Bhuj fault system fall in Zone V.
trapAlert: Delhi is Zone IV; Northeast India and Kutch are in Zone V.
explanation: Seismic Zone V covers Northeast India, parts of J&K, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rann of Kutch, and Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
explanationHindi: भूकंपीय क्षेत्र V (अति गंभीर) में पूर्वोत्तर भारत, कच्छ (गुजरात), अंडमान-निकोबार और हिमालयी पट्टी शामिल हैं।

question: The catastrophic flash flood that struck Sikkim on 4 October 2023, destroying the Chungthang Dam (Teesta-III HEP), was primarily triggered by:
questionHindi: 4 अक्टूबर 2023 को सिक्किम में आई विनाशकारी बाढ़, जिसने चुंगथांग बांध (तीस्ता-III जलविद्युत परियोजना) को नष्ट कर दिया था, मुख्य रूप से किसके कारण उत्पन्न हुई थी?
options: A Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) from South Lhonak Lake
An earthquake of magnitude 8.0 on the Main Central Thrust
The overflow of the Indira Gandhi Canal
A cyclone making landfall directly over the Sikkim Himalaya
optionsHindi: दक्षिण ल्होनक झील से हिमनद झील प्रस्फोट बाढ़ (GLOF)
मेन सेंट्रल थ्रस्ट पर 8.0 तीव्रता का भूकंप
सिक्किम हिमालय पर सीधे टकराने वाला चक्रवात
hints: Hint 1: Glacial retreat in North Sikkim created a large moraine-dammed lake at >5,200 m altitude.
Hint 2: An ice avalanche or cloudburst breached the terminal moraine.
Hint 3: Millions of cubic meters of water surged down the Teesta river gorge.
trapAlert: South Lhonak GLOF is the standard case study for Himalayan cryosphere hazards in recent policy discussions.
explanation: The Sikkim disaster was caused by a GLOF from South Lhonak Lake in North Sikkim, releasing a flood wave down the Teesta basin that washed away the 1,200 MW Teesta-III dam.
explanationHindi: सिक्किम आपदा उत्तर सिक्किम की दक्षिण ल्होनक झील में हिमनद झील प्रस्फोट (GLOF) के कारण उत्पन्न हुई थी।

question: Question 341: Under the Disaster Management Act, 2005, who serves as the ex-officio Chairperson of the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)?
questionHindi: प्रश्न 341: आपदा प्रबंधन अधिनियम, 2005 के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपदा प्रबंधन प्राधिकरण (NDMA) का पदेन अध्यक्ष कौन होता है?
options: The Union Minister of Home Affairs
hints: Hint 1: NDMA is the apex policy-making body for disaster management in India.
Hint 2: State Disaster Management Authorities (SDMAs) are headed by State Chief Ministers.
Hint 3: The Prime Minister of India heads the NDMA.
trapAlert: Home Minister heads the National Executive Committee; Prime Minister heads NDMA.
explanation: Under Section 3(2) of the Disaster Management Act 2005, the Prime Minister of India is the ex-officio Chairperson of the NDMA.

question: Which was the FIRST Biosphere Reserve established in India (in 1986), spanning across the states of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka?
